name: Histogram-Based Automatic Transfer Function for Multi-Modal Blending
aliases: Automatic Transfer Function Calculation for T2 Blending
Fuzzy C-Means Clustering for Pathological Tissue Detection
T1/FLAIR Blending with Automatic Transfer Function
definition: A method to blend anatomical structures from T1-weighted data with pathological structures from FLAIR data by automatically calculating a transfer function based on histogram analysis of fuzzy clustered data.
